claims.explanation: The source directly states that all electricity interconnections with Russia and Belarus have been permanently disconnected as part of the Baltic synchronisation process with the Continental Europe Synchronous Area. It details the disconnection starting on 8 February 2025 and the successful synchronisation on 9 February 2025, confirming the permanent nature of the disconnection and the independence gained from the Russian-Belorussian system.
claims.missing: No significant details about any remaining temporary connections or exceptions are mentioned, so the claim about permanent disconnection is fully supported by the source.
